text: Since lunch my husband can't move his left arm and his mouth looks crooked.
I wet myself twice today and my lower back is killing me.
There's a crushing pressure in the middle of my chest going to my left arm.
Sciatica down my right leg for a month, no other issues.
My hip replacement was ten days ago and my whole leg is now puffy and warm.
I'd like rehab sessions after my ACL surgery last month.
Ammi ki awaz achanak se ajeeb ho gayi hai aur bazu nahi utha pa rahi.
Kamar dard ke saath peshab khud hi nikal jata hai.
Mujhe frozen shoulder ke liye exercises seekhni hain.
Saans lene mein mushkil ho rahi hai jab se gira hoon.
Teen din se bukhar hai aur ghutna sooj ke laal ho gaya hai.
Gardan mein dard hai mobile zyada use karne se.
ابو کی ایک طرف کی ٹانگ اچانک کام نہیں کر رہی۔
دل کے پاس دباؤ ہے اور پسینہ آ رہا ہے۔
ایڑی میں صبح کے وقت درد ہوتا ہے۔
رات کو درد سے آنکھ کھل جاتی ہے اور بھوک بھی نہیں لگتی، وزن گر رہا ہے۔
Mainu chhati wich bara dard ho reha ae te saah nai aunda.
Gode wich dard ae, purana masla ae.
Fall ke baad se head mein bohat pain hai aur ulti aa rahi hai.
Office chair pe baith ke upper back stiff ho jati hai.
